snippet.title: Greenhearth Necromancer | Release Date Announcement Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
Raise a garden from the dead when Greenhearth Necromancer launches on Steam on May 11, 2026. 
Wishlist now ➤https://store.steampowered.com/app/2127570/Greenhearth_Necromancer/ 

A cozy, semi-idle gardening sim where necromancy helps things grow.

Tend to your balcony garden, revive wilted plants into thriving undead flora, and let your little ecosystem flourish, even while you’re away. Designed to sit beside you as you work, study, or unwind.

🌿 Grow and care for your balcony garden at your own pace
🪦 Revive dead plants into unique undead companions
☕ Built for second-screen play—perfect for WFH or studying
🌱 Check in, cast spells, and let your garden thrive in the background
🎧 Relax with ambient vibes as your space slowly comes to life

No pressure. No rush. 

Visit indie.io on Steam ➤ https://bit.ly/4e91q5q
 #cozygames #indiegame #idlegame #cozygaming #wfh
